title: Articles 12–13 — State and inconsistency with Fundamental Rights

content.overview: Article 12 defines the State for Part III. Article 13 declares laws inconsistent with or in derogation of Fundamental Rights void to the extent of the inconsistency.
content.study: Article 12 is the gateway. For other authorities, apply instrumentality/agency factors. Article 13 covers pre- and post-Constitution laws; amendment is governed by Article 368 and basic structure.

sections.heading: Article 12 practice
sections.body: Plead facts showing the respondent is State. Private bodies are outside unless instrumentality is established.
